full_judgment:
8. In compliance of the said order, two files LCR of Title Appeal No. 623 of 1999 was sent to this court by memo dated 5-1-2017. After scrutiny of the case record, section reported that except SA Khatian (Exhibit-2) all other Exhibits Nos.1-3 to 14(Ka) are available in the case record, but the record of the Title Suit No. 3 of 1991was not sent to this court. Subsequently, another notice was sent by the office to transmit the record of Senior Assistant Judge, Third Court, Dhaka of Title Suit No. 3 of 1991. Thereafter, Senior Assistant Judge, Third Court, Dhaka, by memo dated 9-1-2017 informed that the LCR of Title Suit No. 3 of 1991 has been destroyed in the year 2015 as such could not send the Lower Court Record. 

 11. It appears that Exhibit-'Ga' is the original registered Sale Deed No. 9400 dated 21-4-1985 executed by Keshob Lal son of late Radhu Mistry and Ahladi Bewa wife of late Ishar Mali of Dhonia, Demra, in favour of Ali Akbor, Samsul Haque son of late Akram Khan of Donia, Police Station-Demra, Dhaka. The certified copy of the said sale deed dated 21-4-1985 was produced by the plaintiffs-petitioners in the trial which was also marked as Exhibit-9. Subsequently, on 26-7-2018 learned Advocate for the petitioner filed photocopy of the original Sale Deed dated 21-4-1985 marked in the Tile Suit No 3 of 1991on 18-7-1999 as (Exhibit-Ga) filed before this court along with the photocopy of SA Khatian (Exhibit-2) which was missing from the LCR and accordingly same was kept with the record. Since both contesting parties agreed that the exhibited documents filed by the defendant-opposite party Nos. 1 and 2 on 16-11-2017 are the same document which was marked in the suit as Exhibit No. 2 and `Ga' respectively. The two documents are kabala dated 21-4-1985 (Exhibit-Ga) and SA khatian (Exhibit-2) which was subsequently filed by the plaintiff petitioner before this court on 26-11-2017. Since all this documents were reconstructed by the learned advocate of both the parties and they have no objection for such reconstruction. Accordingly, the missing documents Exhibit Nos. Ka-Cha filed by the defendants and Exhibit-ga and Exhibit-2 is reconstructed. The above reconstructed Exhibited documents be kept with the record under separate list of documents prepared by this court on 21-1-2019 Accordingly the application for reconstruction of missing Exhibited documents filed by the opposite party is allowed. The list of reconstructed Exhibited document prepared by this court on 21-1-2019 kept with the record. 

 15. The positive case of the plaintiff, is that, the suit land belonged to Ahladi Bewa and CS record was prepared in her name and she died leaving only son Shamboo Nath who died leaving wife Sreemoti Bewa; that Sreemoti Bewa by kabala dated 28-4-1952 sold the land that she got from Shamboo Nath to Khetro Mohan Baroi; that Khetro Mohan Baroi entered into an oral agreement on 14-8-1961 with the plaintiff for selling the land and upon receiving Taka 500 delivered possession to the plaintiff, that prior to the registration of the Kabala Khetro Mohan died leaving two sons, Madhu Sudhan Baroi and Bipod Ranjon Baroi as his heirs and the said two sons upon attaining majority sold on 13-5-1969 the land as to which their father entered into contract to sell to the plaintiff; that SA record was wrongly prepared in the name of Ahladi Bewa and Sadhu Charan and about the said wrong record Khetro Mohan Baroi had knowledge; that plaintiff for correction of the record filed Title Suit No. 101 of 1986 in the Sixth Court of Assistant Judge, Dhaka for correction of SA and RS Khatian and the same was decreed ex-parte on 27-3-1989 that while plaintiff took steps for correction of the record on the basis of the said decree, it was found that the land in the suit has mutated in the name of the defendant on the basis of the forged kabala; that the plaintiff obtained certified copy of the kabala on 22-9-1990 and on the basis of which defendant claimed the land and filed Mutation Case No. 275 of 1990 before the Assistant Commissioner (land) for correction of the record and in due course plaintiffs got their names mutated by cancelling mutation of defendant Nos. 1 and 2; that the defendant having had suffered defeat in the miscellaneous case threatened the plaintiff on 28-12-1990 to dispossess from the suit land. Hence the suit. 

 16. The suit was contested by the defendant Nos. 1 and 2 by filing joint written statement denying the material allegations made in the plaint and contending, interalia, that the suit is barred by limitation; not maintainable and also that Ahladi Bewa was the original owner and CS Khatian was prepared in her name and that SA record was also recorded in the name of Ahladi Bewa and Sadhu Charan Mondal; that defendants entered into contract with Ahladi Bewa and Keshob Lal on 1-10-1975 and the said persons executed several deeds of agreement for sale and delivered possession to the defendants upon receiving Taka 18,000 and subsequently on 20-4-1985 they executed Sale Deed and the defendants have been living in the land by making construction.
